name: Dragon Man

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Cornered: Sırtı duvara dayalıyken bir şampiyon köşeye sıkışmış sayılır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Ineptitude: Yeni Fury, Armor Up, Precision ve Cruelty etkilerinin gücünü azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Dövüşün büyük kısmında pasif güç kazanır; E3 kullanırsa köşeye sıkıştırır ve durdurulamaz+engellenemez olur. Petrify veya güç kontrolü olan şampiyon kullan. Zırh kıran şampiyon kullanma — degeneration uygular.
signatureAbility:
Tactical Programming
When any Non-Science Opponent has specific Buffs active, gain a unique effect. Potency is increased by 100% when fighting Cosmic Champions.
Regen: Reduce Opponents Regen Rate by [10 - 35]%.
Power Gain: Reduce Opponent's Ability Power Rate by [10 - 35]%.
Fury: Gain [305.54 - 1,480.76] Armor Rating.
Armor Up: Gain [1,016.76 - 3,558.78] Attack Rating.
Precision: Gain [305.54 - 1,480.76] Critical Resistance.
Cruelty: Gain [10 - 35]% Critical Damage Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Dragon Man's thick Armor and Advanced Robotics grants full immunity to Bleed, Poison, and Armor Shattered.
If under the effects of an Armor Break, Dragon Man releases currents of mystical energy, dealing [508.4] Degeneration Damage every 0.5 seconds. Damage is increased by 100% against Cosmic Champions.
Offensive Combat Power Rate is reduced by 35%.

abilitySections.title: Power Charge - Buff:
content: At the start of a fight, gain Power Charge, generating 12% of a bar of Power every second. Power Charge is removed when Stunned.
If 0 Power Charges are active, create one after 12 seconds. When Defending, this duration is reduced by 4 seconds.
When fighting Science Champions, upon receiving a Non-Damaging Debuff, pause cooldown Duration for 0.35 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Cornered - Passive:
content: While the Opponent's back is against the wall they gain Cornered. Cornered is unaffected by Ability Accuracy modifications.
Each hit deals [3,558.8] physical damage. This damage is increased by 35% for each Ineptitude or Unique Buff on the Opponent. Up to 105%
Opponents Defensive Combat Power Rate is reduced by 70% while above 2 bars of Power.

abilitySections.title: On Opponent Knockdown:
content: Gain an Unblockable Buff for 3 seconds. Duration is paused during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: On Hit, remove any Incinerates on the Opponent, each dealing a burst of [5,084] energy damage. If 6 or more Incinerates are removed, this damage is increased by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit inflicts a non-stacking Slow for 8 seconds.
The first hit that contacts the Opponent consumes 1 Power Charge to inflict an Ineptitude Debuff reducing the potency of new Fury, Armor Up, Precision, and Cruelty Buffs by 75% for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: All 3 hits of Dragon Man's fire breath inflict Incinerate, dealing [5,084] energy damage over 25 seconds. Incinerate also reduces the Opponent's Block Proficiency by 50% and prevents the activation of Perfect Block.
Consume 1 Power Charge to generate a Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by [6,609.2] for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Consume all stacks of Power Charge. Each contributing 4 seconds to an Unstoppable Buff. While active, this Unstoppable instantly regenerates 85% of hit damage received from Attacks other than Special 3's.
After this Special Attack ends, generate 3 stacks of Power Charge. Additional stacks of Power Charge do not generate additional Power.
